verdict.rationale: Neon documents some official libraries a developer can build against: the Neon serverless driver and the `@neon/config-runtime` package for running inspect/plan/apply from scripts or CI. Agent Skills also reference Neon's SDKs. However, the pack contains only a title for the serverless driver and no documented official management-API SDKs or language coverage, and the OpenAPI codegen spec is only a building block. missing for 10: documented official SDK catalog (languages, packages, versioning), SDK usage docs beyond titles, management-API client libraries, independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: To call the same `inspect` / `plan` / `apply` logic from your own script or CI job instead of the CLI, see `@neon/config-runtime`.
give AI coding assistants accurate knowledge of Neon's platform, APIs, SDKs, and best practices
